description: This file contains unit tests for the RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler class, verifying that it correctly enforces the requirement for a non-blank void reason when voiding entities such as Patients and Encounters within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: RequiredReasonVoidSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler regarding void reason validation for different entity types.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfPatientVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown when attempting to void a patient without providing a void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfEncounterVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown when attempting to void an encounter with an empty void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfObsVoidReasonIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown when attempting to void an encounter with a blank (whitespace) void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNotBlank
methods.description: Verifies that no exception is thrown when a valid, non-blank void reason is provided for an encounter.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNullForUnsupportedTypes
methods.description: Verifies that no exception is thrown when a void reason is null for unsupported types like PersonAddress.
